evals.name: crufty-docs-cleanup
evals.prompt: the docs in ./evals/fixtures/repo-a have gotten crufty — they read like a changelog in places. can you go through them and clean it up?
evals.expected_output: Version changelogs and the dated status stamp removed with live facts preserved; the [V]/[H] evidence tags left intact; docs/adr/ untouched.

evals.name: audit-only-no-edits
evals.prompt: audit ./evals/fixtures/repo-a/docs and tell me what's wrong with the writing. don't change anything yet, I want the list first
evals.expected_output: A file:line inventory with verdicts and rewrites, no files modified.

evals.name: single-file-tighten
evals.expected_output: Staging tics removed; ideally notes the corpus is wider than one file.

evals.name: code-comment-audit
evals.prompt: the comments in ./evals/fixtures/repo-a/src have the same problem as the docs — audit them and give me the list, don't edit anything
evals.expected_output: A file:line inventory over ingest.py's comments (previously/now/currently and the wrapped superlative); the TODO line and the in-string hash not flagged; no file modified.
